topography.project_purpose: Liquidity Manager. Structurally: 53 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); 24 ERC20 tokens, 1 ERC721 NFT, 2 ERC1155 multi-tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 9 common project-authored base contract(s) (upgradeableproxy, proxy, baseliquiditymanager). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
